-- intro: Butoh Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to cast spells through dancing.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to cast spells through dancing. The user is able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires. As the user dances, they enter a trance-like state and their attacks become unpredictable.
-- spell pages: Sea God Slash; Sea God's Descent
